purpose: Result-blind diagnostic proving whether the S0 top1 identity is invariant to the full supported style-fallback perturbation range for |q|<=1. It does not change the frozen confidence gate, ticket rule, price gate, stake, or any purchase decision.

local_replay.execution_note: Deterministic local Python unittest replay; engineering evidence only, not CI, economic evidence, formal support, or profitability evidence.

theorem.sufficient_condition: If the S0 top-score gap to the runner-up is strictly greater than 0.26350806451725767 points, the S0 top1 identity cannot be reversed by any supported style fallback assignment within |q|<=1.
theorem.interpretation_limit: This is only a ranking-stability result. It is not independent-model corroboration, calibration evidence, hit-rate evidence, price evidence, or profitability evidence.

takeo_20260911_r4_anti_overreach_check.why_this_matters: The diagnostic can report stable top1 while the frozen confidence gate still fails. Therefore robustness is not a hidden purchase override and does not convert stability into a bet.

invariants_tested: Reference required score gap is reproduced exactly.
Takeo R5 is robust under the supported fallback bound.
Exact boundary equality is not labeled strictly robust.
A value just above the boundary is robust.
A tied top score is not robust.
Zero q bound reduces the required gap to zero while still requiring a positive lead.
Invalid beta, reversed delta range, negative q bound, non-finite scores and too few scores fail closed.
Input ordering does not change the result.
No result, payout, odds, network fetch, spend or automatic execution is performed by the diagnostic.
